about_the_game:
The full soundtrack to Underway (Remastered) composed by Matt McGreevy with new songs by Charlie Martini! All in a nice package for your ears to enjoy.

(But it might be better if you've played the game first)

Tracks:

01 - "A New Beginning (In The Rain)"

02 - "Feeling Dread"

03 - "Salamanders In The System"

04 - "Bane Of Existence (With The Spice Of Life)"

05 - "The Way Forward Is Bankrupt"

06 - "A New Path"

07 - "Blood Stains On The Floor"

08 - "SHOW ME SALAMANDERS"

09 - "Returning The Favor"

10 - "The Death Is Ringing In Your Ears"

11 - "The Lizards Are Dying"

12 - "Existence Is Better With A Reptile Head"

13 - "Melody Of A Broken Man"

14 - "It's My Doppelgänger."

15 - "Rise To The Darkness"

16 - "Enter The Darkness"

17 - "The Pain Of Existing"

18 - "NO WITNESSES"

19 - "There's Blood On Your Hands."

20 - "Make An Impact."

(Album art by Joaqui Norris and Matt McGreevy)
